situation: Broke up 3 weeks ago. I still have my ex Jordan's guitar, bike helmet and a box of books. Want to hand it all back without a big conversation.
reply: Hi Jordan, I've got your guitar, the bike helmet and the box of books ready. I can leave them with the front desk on Thursday after 5, or you can pick them up Saturday between 10 and 12. Which works?
note: Belongings are logistics only: items, date, method, done.

situation: 分手半年了，前男友突然发了一大段话，说他变了，想复合。我不想，但也不想伤人。
reply: 你的消息我认真看了几遍，想给你一个明确的回答，而不是模棱两可。我的答案是不。不是为了让你难过，是我很清楚自己想要什么。祝你一切都好。
note: 清楚就是善意。如果他继续争取，不用逐条回应，只说“我听到了，我的答案不变”。

situation: My college ex Mateo texted after 4 years saying he's moving back to Chicago and would love to catch up. I'm open to being friends, nothing more.
reply: Mateo, nice to hear from you, and welcome back! I'd be up for a catch-up as friends, no expectations either way. Coffee on Saturday at 11? There's a good place on Armitage.
note: Name the limit up front and pin a date, so it doesn't drift into something vaguer.

situation: Been dating Sam for five months. He's on a research ship until mid-November with email only, no calls. I know I want to end it and I don't think it's fair to wait seven weeks.
reply: Sam, I need to say this now rather than wait until you're back in November, and I'm sorry it's by email. I don't want to carry on the relationship. Being apart has shown me I want something more day to day than we can have, and that's about what I want, not anything you did. I'll post the books and the jacket you left here to your mum's this week. I hope the rest of the voyage goes really well.
note: Breakup in the first two lines, one true reason, belongings sorted, and no 'let's stay friends' unless it's true now.

situation: My ex Priya and I broke up in July after three years. She just texted asking if we can 'be friends like before' before Dani's wedding on Oct 24, where we'll both be. I'm not ready for that.
reply: Thanks for asking, and for reaching out before the wedding. I'm not ready to be friends right now and I don't know when I will be. At Dani's on the 24th I'll say hi and be friendly, and I hope we can both just enjoy the day. I hope you're doing okay.
note: "Not now" is a real answer; the wedding line gives shape to the one meeting they can't avoid.

situation: My ex, Callum, and I split up in August after a year. We're on the same product team with standups every day. He messaged asking to 'grab a drink after work Friday and properly talk things through'. I don't want to.
reply: Hi Callum, thanks for asking rather than letting it get weird at work. I'm not up for a drink or a talk about us, and I'd rather be clear than vague about it. At work I'm glad to keep things normal and friendly, standups, the launch, all of it. Outside of work I need some distance for a while.
note: An ex you see every day: close the door on the personal part and give the working relationship a clear, friendly shape.

situation: Last week I told my ex Dylan I'm not in a place to be in touch. He's sent four long messages since, saying I never gave him a fair chance, listing things he's changed, and asking me to at least meet once to talk.
reply: Dylan, I've read what you sent and I've heard you. I'm not going to argue it point by point, and I won't be meeting up. My answer is the same. I won't reply further, and I do hope things go well for you.
note: Don't answer each point; points invite rebuttal. Restate once, then go quiet, and mute if the messages keep coming.

situation: 和前女友小雅分手两个月了，是和平分手。我们在同一个羽毛球群里，她问我能不能继续做朋友，至少打球的时候别互相躲着。我也愿意，但不想又走得太近。
reply: 谢谢你先开口。我也想做朋友，不过这段时间我觉得在群里、在球场上正常相处就好，单独吃饭和深夜聊天先放一放。周六上午的球我照常去，到时候见，分到一组打双打也没问题。
note: 答应做朋友时要给出形状：哪些场合可以、哪些先不做，再落到一个具体的下一次见面。

situation: My ex Marcus cheated on me and we broke up last October. Tonight he sent a long, honest-sounding apology, saying he's in therapy and just wants me to know he's sorry. He isn't asking for anything. I don't want to reopen things, but I don't want to ignore it either.
reply: Thanks for saying this, Marcus. I read it properly and I believe you mean it. I've moved on and I'm not looking to be in touch, so I'll leave it here. I hope the work you're doing goes well.
note: An apology with no ask still gets a kind full stop: acknowledge it, close the door in one sentence, don't reply to the reply. Draft tonight, send in the morning.

situation: I met my ex Hana for coffee on Saturday as friends, a year after we broke up, and it was nice. Since then she's texted every night, said 'I miss us' last night, and wants dinner just the two of us on Friday. I'm not looking to get back together.
reply: I'm glad we had coffee on Saturday, it was good to see you. I want to be straight so there's no confusion: I'm not looking to get back together, so I'll pass on dinner Friday. I'd still like to be friends, the daytime coffee every few weeks kind, and I'd rather we skip the nightly texts.
note: The door was reopened as friends, so restate the limit plainly and give the friendship a shape; no 'maybe later'.
